text:
nina: FYI planning a small runtime rollout tonight 23:00 UTC. Need someone to pin the RN thread and post internal blurb at cutover.
carl: I can pin and post. Ill put a short announce in draft by 21:30.
jess: Draft blurb: "Deployment: runtime memory optimizations + smarter batching. No public API changes. Expect brief p99 blips during KV cache warmup."
nina: Add rollback criteria please: what signal should trigger an immediate rollback?
carl: Proposed triggers: 5xx rate >= 3% for 5m OR p99 latency >= 2x baseline for 10m. Rollback action: pin to stable v1.3. Command in runbook.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @carl at 2026-03-21T22:55:00Z. Canary: 10% for 20m -> 50% for 10m -> 100%. Heartbeats every 5m.
kim: Suggest extending first canary to 25m because of cache warmup.
jess: Agree with @kim. Also add a short fallback note in blurb: "If rollback, auto-fallback to model v1.3 and contact ops."
carl: Updated cadence with deploy-bot to 10% for 25m. Also added rollback command snippet to draft: 
```
deploybot rollback --release 1745556667 --to v1.3
```
nina: Whos posting at go-time? We need ops standby names in the pinned message.
jess: @carl and @nina on standby; @kim to watch canary dashboards.
deploy-bot: heartbeat 2/6 12m into canary; no error spike.
kim: Observability: p99 +8% first 10m then trending down; batch hit rate improving. No alert.
deploy-bot: heartbeat 6/6 deploy complete to 100%. No rollbacks triggered.
carl: Posting internal announce and pinning now: "Shipped: runtime memory + batching improvements. No public API changes. Ops: @carl @nina @kim on standby. Runbook & rollback cmd pinned."
jess: Tiny edit: change "No public API changes" -> "No user-facing API changes" per docs team.
carl: Done. Pin updated.
nina: Thanks team. Leaving a follow-up check in 24h and will open a micro-postmortem if any regressions appear.
deploy-bot: runbook link: https://internal.redwood/release/1745556667-runbook
